fieldData.answer: Food trucks and drink vendors will be on hand to fill your empty tummy. Some local businesses will also be open during PorchFest hours. Please remember that each venue is someone’s porch, so please be sure that you are respectful and clean up after yourself. No outside food, drink or coolers will be allowed inside the PorchFest area.
fieldData.name: What about food and drinks?

fieldData.answer:
PorchFest is a rain or shine event. Please dress accordingly. You will want to bring a folding chair to carry to each porch/stage. Food and beverage vendors have paid to participate in this event, therefore there will be no outside food, drink or coolers allowed inside the PorchFest area. 

‍
fieldData.name: What should I bring to PorchFest?

fieldData.answer:
This event is designed for walking. If you need to drive to Senoia, please find a convenient parking spot and walk from there. There will be NO motorized vehicles, golf carts, bicycles, or skateboards allowed within the PorchFest perimeter. Limited golf cart shuttles will be assisting patrons to and from parking locations within Senoia, but they will only be able to get patrons to and from the perimeter of the event. 

‍
fieldData.name: Should I walk, park, or drive to PorchFest?

fieldData.answer: Organizers, performers, and porch hosts are all giving freely of their time and talents. If you would like to support a band, please make a donation in the tip jars provided or via the QR codes on the PorchFest signage.
fieldData.name: Do the musicians get paid?

fieldData.answer:
An event map and schedule will be available once the bands and porches have been selected at https://www.enjoysenoia.com/events/senoia-porchfest-2023 and on the Enjoy Senoia social media. We will also have printed maps and maps posted at the major intersections during PorchFest.

fieldData.name: Is there a map or a schedule?

fieldData.answer:
PorchFest is a FREE event for participants. Tips for the musicians are encouraged. Food and drinks will be available to purchase. Artwork from local artisans will be available for sale. Check out one band or twenty! Stay for 20 minutes or all afternoon! VIP experience tickets are $10 each and are available at https://www.enjoysenoia.com/events/senoia-porchfest-2023. 

‍
fieldData.name: Do I need a ticket? What does PorchFest cost?

fieldData.answer: Anyone and everyone! PorchFest Senoia is family-friendly and features a wide variety of music – so there’s sure to be a band or performance that sparks your interest.
fieldData.name: Who should attend PorchFest?

fieldData.answer: We have bands and solo artists of various genres who will be performing at 20 different venues. Band announcements will be made on https://www.enjoysenoia.com/events/senoia-porchfest-2023 and on the Enjoy Senoia social media.
fieldData.name: What music will be performed at PorchFest?

fieldData.answer: Neighbors offer their porches or yards, performers and artists volunteer their talents. We pair musicians with porches and yards and artists with street locations. Food trucks and beverage proprietors will provide yummy food and drinks. The Children’s Corner will provide young porchfesters with games and crafts. Music, art, food and drink will be enjoyed between 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM on Sunday, September 3, 2023.
fieldData.name: How does PorchFest work?

fieldData.answer: PorchFest Senoia is organized by volunteers and sponsored by the Senoia Downtown Development Authority and local vendors. A list of the sponsors will be available on signage throughout the event, on the Enjoy Senoia website and on the Enjoy Senoia, Georgia Facebook page and on the EnjoySenoia Instagram page.
fieldData.name: Who is organizing this event?

fieldData.answer: PorchFest is a hometown neighborhood and community celebration where porches and yards become stages for local and regional bands and musicians. Senoia’s streets become artist galleries and walk-up restaurants
fieldData.name: What is PorchFest?

fieldData.answer: Outside coolers are not allowed at PorchFest. Food and drinks are available to purchase from the PorchFest vendors.

If you have purchased a VIP table, you can stop by the Welcome Center at 68 Main Street in downtown Senoia to pick up your VIP table wristbands beginning on Tuesday, May 23rd.  During the week before Memorial Day Weekend, the Welcome Center will be open Tuesday, 05/23, through Friday, 05/26, from 11-3 and on Saturday, 05/27, from 10-4.

Eight (8) wristbands will be provided per VIP table. You will be responsible for distributing wristbands to those sitting at your table. Any VIP ticket purchasers who do not pick up their wristbands before the event can do so at the DDA tent, near the VIP area at the event. You will need either the e-ticket provided via email when you purchased your ticket, or the name, address and contact phone number or email address used when VIP table was purchased online.
